      "quote": "We should never be hitting a code path where a re-initialization is possible, and this seems to relax that requirement. I think rather than messing with `Init`, we should seriously reconsider whether this data can be initialized at construction.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author initialized txdata at construction; sedited approved the changes in r:5278446176",

      "status_by_id": "r:5278446176",
      "status_by_quote": "ACK on the changes"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4071932839",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "remove Init() entirely rather than keeping it as a helper",
      "quote": "Why not remove it entirely? The diff from doing so is small.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author removed Init() and moved its body directly into the constructor",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4077551951", "r:5285090033"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4077551951",
      "status_by_quote": "I removed `Init()` entirely and moved its body into the constructor - beautiful!"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5278446176",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "which staleness is specifically being prevented by this change",
      "quote": "Which staleness are we exactly preventing with this change?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "fametrano detailed how sequential Init calls across transactions retained cached BIP143 hashes",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": ["c:6397135997"],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6397135997",
      "status_by_quote": "On which staleness this prevents: on the base (7988380da9), `Init(A, {})` for a transaction with a witness, then `Init(B, spent_outputs)` for one without, passes the old `assert(!m_spent_outputs_ready)`"
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5278446176",
      "verdict": "ACK",

      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "both",
      "areas": ["src/script/interpreter.cpp", "kernel API"]
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Added sedited's suggestion to remove Init() and question on staleness, answered by fametrano who also provided a substantive Tested ACK.",

    {
      "on": "reviewer",

      "id": "r:5285090033"
    }
  ]
}
